title: 指代与词汇复现
goal: 利用指代和词汇复现判断句间联系。

points.label: 根据指代词找到相应对象或事件
利用词汇复现确认话题连续性

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）课表

body.p: 句子之间可以通过指代和词汇复现保持联系。判断时既要找到对应的对象，也要核对句子的意思。

body.box: Mia borrowed a map. She returned it after the walk.

body.p: it 指 a map，returned 说的是把借来的地图还回去。核对指代时，单复数要一致，动作也要说得通。

cards.title: 指代词
rows: This delayed the trip. 指车辆迟到。
A tunnel was built under the road.
This connects the two parks. 指隧道。
They then labeled the boxes. 指志愿者。
They switch off at midnight. 指灯。
Some paths are too narrow for cars.
Such paths are suitable for walking. 指这类小路。
In such cases, the team works indoors. 指下雨耽误工作的情况。
A new one will hold the fruit. 指新篮子。
A pencil is needed for the sketch.
A soft one makes darker marks. 指软铅笔。

cards.title: 词汇复现
rows: The bridge links two villages. 两句都讲桥。
The gate stays open by day. 两句都讲门。
The slope makes cycling difficult. slope 对应陡坡。
The work finished on Friday. work 指这次维修。
The bird picked up a seed. bird 概括 robin。
A hammer lay on top. hammer 是工具。

body.box:
Lena found a torn poster in the hall. ____ She put the repaired poster back on the wall.
1. She mended it with a strip of paper.
2. She drew a map of the hall.
3. The wall needed a new coat of paint.
4. The poster announced a music class.

body.p: 第一项的 it 指 torn poster，mended 对应后句的 repaired。第四项也有 poster，但讲的是海报内容，接不上后句的 repaired。

groups.text: The camera fell into water. ____ The owner then dried its case.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: The owner took a photograph.
The case was on a shelf.
This damaged the camera.
A different case was dry.
items.why: This 指前句的相机落水。落水损坏了相机，所以后句主人把外壳晾干。

groups.text: Two bakers prepared the dough. ____ Afterward, the loaves cooled on a rack.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: They shaped it into loaves.
They washed the cooling rack thoroughly.
It was a wooden bread rack.
The loaves had already cooled.
items.why: They 指 bakers，it 指 dough。面团做成 loaves，后句接着讲面包放凉。

groups.text: A violin was left in the music room. ____ Its owner collected it after lunch.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: The owner ate lunch in the music room.
Another room held a piano.
The music class ended at noon.
A teacher kept the instrument safe.
items.why: instrument 是 violin 的上义词，指同一把小提琴。老师先代为保管，后句主人再取回。

groups.text: The workshop fixed a damaged chair. ____ The customer collected it later.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: The workshop needed a new chair.
The repair took one afternoon.
The workshop closed later that day.
The chair damaged the floor.
items.why: repair 复现前句的 fixed a damaged chair，指同一次修理。修好之后，后句讲顾客取回椅子。

groups.text: The gardeners planted beans beside the fence. ____ The plants soon climbed it.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the gap?
options: The fence had a blue gate.
The beans were cooked at home.
They watered the young plants.
The fence was taken down.
items.why: They 指 gardeners，young plants 指刚种下的豆子。后句的 The plants 接着讲豆苗爬上篱笆。

groups.text:
The community hall needed more light for an evening craft class. A group of residents brought several lamps from home. ____ The extra light made it easier to see the thread. After the class, each resident took home the lamp they had brought.

A separate table held spare needles. A box beside it contained thread for the class. ____ Nobody had to leave the hall to buy another needle. At the end of the evening, the teacher counted the supplies and returned them to the box. ____ The next class could use the same supplies.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the first gap?
options: They placed them beside the worktables.
They carried the thread to the hall.
The class took place in daylight.
The residents returned the needles home.
items.why: They 指 residents，them 指 lamps。后句的 The extra light 就是这些灯带来的光。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the second gap?
options: The thread was left at home.
The lamps were returned after class.
The teacher had forgotten to bring needles.
These needles were available to everyone.
items.why: These needles 指前面的 spare needles。针够大家用，所以后句说没人需要出去买针。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the third gap?
options: The class was held outdoors.
The materials were ready for reuse.
The lamps were needed at home.
The residents bought another table.
items.why: materials 复现前句的 supplies。ready for reuse 与后句 could use the same supplies 一致。

groups.text:
A school display showed several handmade kites. One kite had a long tail, while another had a bright red frame. ____ The pupils hung them above the entrance. Visitors could see both designs as they came in.

The class had also written a guide to making kites. ____ Its pages explained how to attach a frame and balance a tail. A visitor asked for a copy, and the teacher gave her one. ____ The guide was therefore available to other visitors as well.

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the first gap?
options: The entrance had a red door.
A visitor entered the school.
Both were made from light paper.
The frame was painted after class.
items.why: Both 指前句的两只风筝，后句的 them 也指它们。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the second gap?
options: The booklet was placed near the display.
The entrance remained closed all day.
The kite with the long tail hung highest.
The teacher had no copy to give away.
items.why: booklet 复现前句的 guide，指同一本册子。后句的 Its pages 接着说明册子的内容。

items.stem: Which sentence best fills the third gap?
options: The visitor took the last copy home.
The teacher kept the only copy.
The pupils had written only one copy.
More copies remained on the table.
items.why: copies 复现前句的 copy。桌上还有册子，所以后句说其他访客也能拿到。
